cases.note: the mindustry/ tree with its source roots, no symlinks, VCS metadata or compiled artifacts
every Java source under core/src and server/src compiles offline against the pinned server jar

cases.id: server:processor output reaches a linked message block
server:linked blocks are named after their block type
server:sensor of an unsupported property yields null
server:print output is capped at 400 characters
server:format fills a placeholder when the print buffer is full
server:a replaced linked block is reachable under its new name
server:other links keep their names when one linked block is replaced
server:processor variables survive a save and reload
server:a world processor holding query results can be saved

clauses.anchor: Expected behaviour, first bullet: sensor sets its output to null for values that are neither content nor a supported logic property; supported reads keep working
Expected behaviour, second bullet: a linked block replaced by a different block is renamed like a fresh link; unchanged links keep their names; new links are named after their block
Expected behaviour, third bullet: format replaces the lowest placeholder even in a full buffer and cuts it to 400 characters; order and the 400-character print limit keep working
Expected behaviour, fourth bullet: worlds whose world processors hold query results save and load; processor code and ordinary variables survive saving
Context, last paragraph: changes stay inside mindustry/core/src and mindustry/server/src, which the server build compiles
clauses.note: enforced only through the offline build of those source roots
